title: **📹 Video of the Martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution's Important Speech Overlaid on Images of the Head of the Judiciary's Presence at Friday Prayers in Delhi**
text:
**📹 Video of the Martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution's Important Speech Overlaid on Images of the Head of the Judiciary's Presence at Friday Prayers in Delhi**"

"🔺Yesterday, Mohseni-Ejei attended Friday prayers in Delhi. Iran's Head of Justice joined the Friday prayer congregation led by Delhi's Sunni imam — an event that drew significant attention from Indian users and media."

"🔺An Indian account shared images of this presence at Delhi's Jama Masjid, overlaying statements from the Martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution on the topic of unity among Muslims."

""
"- The act of Iran's Shia judiciary chief praying behind a Sunni imam in Delhi was widely interpreted as a symbolic gesture of Shia–Sunni unity.
